description: Frozen oracle targets for the deterministic battletest. Each target is a real repo copied to /tmp at a pinned SHA. The harness re-freezes the copy, INJECTS one deterministic single-line regression into a NON-TEST source file, drives clio to repair it, then grades with the repo's OWN offline gate plus a programmatic test-edit ban. Pass = gate exit 0 after clio's fix. The green->inject->red->revert->green preflight (battletest_clio.py prepare) proves the oracle is non-vacuous before any model runs. `find` must occur exactly once in the clean source; the harness asserts that and refuses to inject otherwise.

voipi.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run --exclude test/index.test.ts
voipi.symptom: Running the MCP launcher through `npx` no longer passes the `-y` flag, so the launch stalls on an interactive install prompt instead of running non-interactively; meanwhile `pnpx` and `bunx` wrongly receive `-y`.

sandcastle.gate: npm test -- --exclude src/sandboxes/podman.test.ts --exclude src/cli.test.ts && npm run typecheck
sandcastle.symptom: The bounded output tail discards recent lines even when the total output is well under the size limit, so only the very last appended line survives instead of the full retained tail.

graphify.install: uv venv --seed && uv pip install -e . pytest
graphify.gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_cache.py tests/test_claude_md.py tests/test_detect.py tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_ingest.py tests/test_install.py tests/test_security.py tests/test_transcribe.py tests/test_validate.py tests/test_watch.py
graphify.symptom: Editing only the YAML frontmatter of a Markdown file (leaving the body text unchanged) incorrectly invalidates its cache entry, as if the body content had changed.
